story.title: Two friends
paragraphs_en: Gaju and Raju were two friends living in a forest.
Because of the good friendship of the two, they used to walk in the desert, eat, play, and get together.
One day Raju wanted to eat coconut in a tree outside the forest.
He told it to Gaju too. Gaju became happy.
But the problem was that neither of the two could reach the coconut. Then Raju said, I collect coconut, you need to push the tree.
﻿ Gaju shook the tree loudly. The coconut began to fall down the same instant.
And all the coconuts fell like stones on Gaju
﻿ Gaju started to run from there. And one of the coconuts fell on Raju's head. Both of them fled towards the dense forest.
